facts.statement: A free trial membership was offered all weekend; non-member players had access to membership content during the trial, and members could keep status by choosing a multi-month payment option at the end.
facts.quote: we are offering a free trial membership all weekend long. All non-member players will have access to the membership content

article_summaries.title: Double Station Cash and Free Trial Membership Weekend
article_summaries.summary: SOE's news post (captured July 2010) announcing a Fourth of July weekend promotion: prepaid Free Realms Station Cash retail cards redeemed in the window return double their value in Station Cash, and a free trial membership weekend gives non-members access to member content. Members-only items stay usable after the trial only if a membership is purchased.
